import polars as pl
import narwhals as nw

# Scan parquet file lazily using polars backend
lazy_frame = nw.from_native(pl.scan_parquet("events.parquet"))

# Build lazy pipeline: filter -> select -> collect
df = (
    lazy_frame
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select(["user", "duration"])
    .collect()
)

print(df)
